name: What stages are involved in building a kitchen addition?

mainEntity.name: What stages are involved in building a kitchen addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: A kitchen addition involves structural foundation work, exterior tie-ins, custom framing, rough plumbing, electrical upgrades, insulation, drywall, finish carpentry, and tile installation. The process begins with planning, architectural drawings, and local building permits. Once foundation work and framing are complete, licensed sub-trades install the rough electrical lines and plumbing rough-ins. Next, crews complete drywall installation, painting, custom cabinetry, countertop placement, and tile backsplashes or flooring. Because structural changes impact load-bearing walls and utility lines, coordinating trade work step-by-step is essential to keeping the project moving efficiently.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves design and permitting, foundation and framing, rough plumbing and electrical, drywall, painting, cabinetry, tile installation, and final trim.
